# Liquid Glass Effect highlights

Source: https://github.com/kevinbism/liquid-glass-effect
Revision: 493b710b41d817cbdc3b60808e87ce747d7916f6
MIT, Copyright (c) 2025 Kevin Ramirez. Full notice: LICENSE.

Qrer adapts only the inset edge-highlight pattern for its LiquidFrame and
GlassPaint appearances. Original relevant CSS is retained in rim-source.css.
No upstream global resets, layout, images, music widgets or page content is used.
Refraction remains provided by Qrer's existing MIT rendering engines.
